name: Hexed Pet: Rabbit
source:
In a world where curses exist, those with a grudge or some sort of evil purpose cause misfortune on others by placing a curse on them. Like this young man, who was cursed into a rabbit. Forgetting everything about his life as a human, he thinks he's an animal.  Now he behaves like one! 

Micah, due to his abilities, is the only person who is able to see the rabbit in his true form. a human. The only way for those who are under a curse to turn back to normal is by helping them remember their human identity. So. Who is this boy? And why is he cursed? 

While that's going on, Micah's best friend, Asher, seems to be acting suspicious.

Would romance develop with the young man you're taking care of or with your best friend?

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/hexed-pet-rabbit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个存在诅咒的世界里，心怀怨恨或恶意的人，会通过诅咒给别人带来不幸。就像这位被变成兔子的年轻男子。他忘记了身为人类时的一切，认为自己是一只动物，如今连行为举止也与兔子无异！

凭借特殊能力，米卡是唯一能看见这只兔子真正模样的人，那其实是一名人类。让受诅咒者恢复正常的唯一办法，就是帮助他们记起自己身为人类的身份。那么，这个男孩究竟是谁？又为什么会受到诅咒？

与此同时，米卡最好的朋友阿舍尔，似乎也在做些可疑的事。

爱情会在你与正在照顾的青年之间萌生，还是会发生在你与挚友之间？

[摘自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/hexed-pet-rabbit]itch.io[/url]]
